instruction: Repair `broken_amp.sch` with minimal edits and save `/home/user/Desktop/answer.sch`; do not redraw the circuit. For this task, start EAGLE from `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` and open `broken_amp.sch` there. Preserve the total part and net counts. Fix the four seeded structural faults: one duplicate net name, one net with only a single pin reference, one empty R/C/L value, and one physical part/gate/pin assignment that is incorrectly shared by two nets. Every final net must have at least two pin references, net names must be unique within a sheet, every R/C/L refdes must have a nonempty value, every pin reference must name a defined part, and each physical pin may belong to only one net.
